# T21 determinism gate (M3 exit; M4 panel-clear re-baseline): s02_start, diff build
# (SKI_HARNESS=ON SKI_DETERMINISTIC=ON). Run twice, fresh Chrome --user-data-dir per
# run, ?nopump=1, identical ski_in.bin; 401 frames each (0..400); per-frame sha256.
#
# M4 re-baseline (this commit): the shim now emulates wine's WM_ERASEBKGND (fill the
# client with the class stock-0 white brush before each WM_PAINT) AND invalidates a
# window when the game draws to its DC outside a paint (the status-panel value draw,
# ski_status_draw_values -> TextOutA). The status panel no longer accumulates its
# subpixel-AA text (verified crisp vs the original: s03 frame 700 panel 0px; original
# s03 frames 500/700 crisp). 388/401 s02 frames changed (panel region now cleared);
# the masked (main-window) 8-scenario 0px result is unaffected. Re-verified
# deterministic: two fresh runs, 401/401 identical.
